{{Event infobox | location = Lost Basilica | type = Group event | indicator = cog | level = 80 | meta event = The Basilica Vaults | coordinates = [6919.91, 57811.19] | previous = Gather the loose magic for Isgarren | requires = voe }} [[Defeat the champion enchanted weapon]] is the final part of the [[The Basilica Vaults]] [[meta event]]. == Objectives == * Champion Enchanted Staff
{{event bar}} {{event boss}} * Illusory Progenitor destroyed: x/3 == Rewards == {{section-stub|event|Missing more rewards}} {{event rewards}} * One event [[Bonus chest|bouncy chest]]: ** {{rewards item|Antiquated Ducats|qty=25}} ** {{rewards item|Piece of Unidentified Gear|qty=1-2|chance=chance}} ** {{rewards item|Piece of Rare Unidentified Gear|qty=1|chance=chance}} ** One of the following: *** {{rewards item|Bead of Liquid Karma|qty=1|chance=chance}} *** {{rewards item|Drip of Liquid Karma|qty=1|chance=chance}} * Bonus Chest: ** {{rewards item|Starlit Weald Renown Token|qty=1|notes=2 with [[Prosperity Unending]] mastery}} * {{rewards item|Castoran Cache of Riches|notes=with [[Natural Abundance]] mastery}} == NPCs == === Allies === * [[Isgarren]] === Foes === {{section-stub|event}} * [[Champion Enchanted Staff]] * [[Illusory Enchanted Staff]] * [[Illusory Enchanted Sword]] * [[Illusory Enchanted Torch]] * [[Elite Illusory Elite Enchanted Staff]] * [[Elite Illusory Elite Enchanted Sword]] * [[Elite Illusory Elite Enchanted Torch]] == Objects == * [[Illusory Progenitor]] == Dialogue == ;Upon Illusory Progenitors and their illusions spawning (when the champion reaches 90%) :'''Isgarren:''' ''Find and destroy the source of them, unless you enjoy being overwhelmed.'' ;Event success :'''Isgarren:''' ''I trust you're not worn out by such light work, Wayfinder.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''Now, let us see if we've outpaced our vertically challenged adversaries.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''This chamber has been disturbed but made to appear untouched.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''Normally, when [[Inquest]] miscreants rummage through an [[Astral Ward]] storehouse, it looks like a [[skritt]] raid afterward.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''If they felt the need to cover their tracks, I fear they must have found what they were after.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''I will have the ward collect the rest.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''If there's anything here that would be...useful to you, now would be the time to abscond with it.'' [[fr:Vaincre l'arme enchantée championne]]
title: Defeat the champion enchanted weapon
